diagnosis.visibleError: Error: Failed to execute 'fetch' on 'Window': Illegal invocation
diagnosis.failedResourceResult: Failed to execute 'fetch' on 'Window': Illegal invocation
diagnosis.verifiedCause: ResourceClient.get invokes its stored fetcher as this.fetcher(...), binding this to the ResourceClient instance; the browser Window fetch implementation rejects that receiver.
diagnosis.serverCollectionContract: HTTP 200 ActivityStreams OrderedCollection; orderedItems contains the Player catalog Asset, Variety, and AssetGrant objects.
diagnosis.priorTestEvidence: The test directly fetched the public collection before the DOM criterion and asserted orderedItems.length === 3, but did not inspect the IDs.
diagnosis.causalFinding: The rendered resource click fails at fetch invocation before a collection response can be rendered; this does not establish missing public collection objects.
diagnosis.minimalFixRecommendation: Invoke the ResourceClient fetcher with the global/Window receiver or bind it when ResourceClient is constructed; preserve the rendered-DOM assertion.

resolution.implementationChange: packages/resources/src/index.ts stores the fetcher in a local variable and invokes it directly.
